Purpose: Final boundary freeze for the V16.14–V16.18 approval chain. Freezes all approval states at 'ready but not approved'. Documents the hard limit: no endpoint implementation has been authorized, no production trace has been captured, and no runtime influence has been activated. This freeze is the structural endpoint of the V16 approval chain.

BoundaryFreeze.FrozenStateMeaning: All V16.14–V16.18 approval gates are READY, but no endpoint implementation is APPROVED. The approval chain confirms readiness to proceed; it does NOT authorize implementation. Actual implementation requires a separate decision beyond the approval chain.
BoundaryFreeze.EndpointImplementationFinalApprovalReady: FINAL APPROVAL READY means the approval chain is complete and all criteria are satisfied. It does NOT mean FinalApproved. FinalApproved=false.
BoundaryFreeze.EndpointImplementationFinalApprovedInter: Implementation is NOT approved. The approval chain validates readiness, not authorization. Actual implementation requires an explicit go/no-go decision.
